notes.title: Version 14 Release
notes.content: [p][b]Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adpocalypse GameMode, Clear as many popups as you can before you get overwhelmed![/p][/*][*][p]News App, it will show you the most recent update to the game, or news on other major projects that I have![/p][/*][*][p]Discord Server Desktop Button, Click it to join the Official MeowWare Discord Server![/p][/*][*][p]Total Popups Closed Tracking, I will be adding a Leaderboard to track who closes the most soon![/p][/*][*][p]Total Plays for each Gamemode, A Leaderboard will also be added for this soon![/p][/*][*][p]Drag and Drop Functionality for each App in the main Menu![/p][/*][*][p]Popup close sound, when you close any popup, a small sound will play![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Draggability of popups so it now works properly, click and hold to move, release to stop![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Playtime tracking so that it actually starts and displays properly in the Main Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some popups not closing properly when attempting to close them.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Sound Engine to now allow for music and effect audio to play at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Credits App to be slightly cleaner.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted most Apps Sizes so they don't feel as empty.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some unused files to shrink file size a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]A lot of small backend changes to make code more efficient, more readable, and just nicer to work with.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Version 15 Hopefuls![/b][/p][list][*][p]New Popup Type[/p][/*][*][p]New Popup Images[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Polish Current Popups[/p][/*][*][p]add some new features and secrets :)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, check out the Changelog in game for a full list of all changes in this update! If you encounter any bugs, let me know in the Community Discussion or Discord server, and I will get to work on them immediately![/p]

notes.title: V13 is available now!
notes.content:
Additions:
3 new popups, including 1 new minigame!
- Added Countdown Popup, it spawns more popups!
- Added a Laser Light Popup, I plan on adding some decorations to it soon!
- Added a High Risk Popup, roll a dice and see if you are lucky or unlucky, closes or spawns the number of popups indicated on the die!
- Added text descriptions to each of the apps, including descriptions for each minigame in the Training app
- Changed the shape of the cup in the Fill the Cup minigame to be more cuplike
- Made some backend code changes to allow for more additions in the future
- Changed which popups spawn with each App, so you can no longer spawn additional popups in the Zen game mode.
- Changed the yellow Circle in the maze minigame to the cheese wedge icon

As always, check out the full update log in the Changelog in game!
I am hoping to include more large changes for v14 very soon, so keep your eyes peeled!

notes.title: V11 Is Out now!

Check out the Changelog in game for a full list of changes!

notes.title: Small v10 update
notes.content:
Thank you SirSlender for fixing the mouse dropdown in the settings!

Added:
- Screen Resolution Setting
- Screen Background Color Setting
- 3 new Achievements
- New Achievement Image
- Playtime Display on Achievement Display in the Main Menu

Changes:
- Restored quit game functionality
- Fixed mouse Cursor Setting
- Fixed Fullscreen Setting
- Fixed some background logic

This update is a huge sigh of relief for me. I have been struggling for the better part of a month to get anything done, and fix the issues that have been making the game nearly unplayable. This update is a short clean-up update to help give players some more customization, while also prepping the code for more future updates! Steam achievements still seem to elude me, but hopefully there is at least some partial functionality now!

V11 Plans:
I am considering adding another minigame to v11, as well as adding several achievements and more settings to make the game more enjoyable. I also hope to get a couple more popups made to increase the diversity of what you can experience while playing. 

Lastly,
Please feel free to give me suggestions, feedback, and critiques so that I can continue to make this game better for everyone!
